- **Found via:** filed this run
- **Task:** Filed this issue: `RateAuthorisation::validate` in the new `pkgs/id/src/currency.rs` (PR #3888, main c3fda1c4) checks only issuer and `rate_den != 0` (currency.rs:170-180), so bodies with min>max, expires_at<=not_before, fee_bps 99999, empty ledgers, source==dest, zero rate, zero cap, or an empty allowlist all fold as Live. Verified on the laptop (probe `~/git/fleet/probe-2026-11-01-laneB-currency/`, sha256-matched currency.rs): all nine shapes return Ok(()); the rate_den=0 control is rejected.
- **Expectation:** effort s; done when validate rejects the inconsistent shapes with named variants (or documents the arguably-dead ones as valid), each covered by a test.
- **Links:** #4069 https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/4069 · #3801 https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/3801 · #2290 https://github.com/developing-today/code/issues/2290

- **Confirmed on current main** (origin/main @ 2ab643efb): `RateAuthorisation::validate` (pkgs/id/src/currency.rs:152-160) still checks only issuer + `rate_den != 0` — logic verbatim identical to the probed version (only intervening change to the file is #4131 note.link events, elsewhere in the file). `fold_authorisation`'s only validity gate is still `body.validate(author).is_ok()` (line 289). All struct fields named in this issue (min/max, not_before/expires_at, fee_bps, ledgers, rate_num, total_cap, authorised_callers) are present and uninspected by validate, so all nine inconsistent shapes still validate Ok and fold Live. - **Routing:** fix packet enqueued as a `small_fix` — named `ValidateError` variants for min>max, expires_at<=not_before, fee_bps>10000, empty/same ledgers; zero rate/cap and empty allowlist either rejected or documented-valid with one tested rule; per-shape tests + existing suite green.
- **Expectation:** effort s; fix lands as a PR against pkgs/id/src/currency.rs.

- **Found via:** filed this run as #4414 before my dedup search results arrived; closing it as a duplicate of this issue and handing over the two findings it adds
- **Task:** (1) `sign_authorisation` (currency.rs:313-336) never calls `validate` — even the two existing checks are sign-time unenforced, so an issuer can publish a zero-denominator authorisation the fold silently drops while believing it live; #4071's acceptance criteria cover `validate` and the fold, not the sign path. (2) Fold-shadowing confirmed end-to-end on current main: good v1 + inverted-bounds v2 folds `Live` version 2 (the malformed successor is crowned, the good v1 unreachable), verified in the same probe as the validate cases.
- **Expectation:** fold these two points into this issue's fix scope if the holder agrees; the rest of #4414 duplicates this issue's evidence and criteria.

## Triage verdict: CONFIRMED on current origin/main

Verified read-only against `origin/main` at `e2a32316a` (no builds, no source edits):

- `pkgs/id/src/currency.rs:152-160` `RateAuthorisation::validate` checks only `issuer_id != author` (`IssuerMismatch`) and `rate_den == 0` (`ZeroRateDenominator`), then `Ok(())`.
- `ValidateError` has only those two variants (lines 214-218); no variants for bounds, window, fee, or ledger shapes.
- `fold_authorisation` gates liveness solely on `body.validate(author).is_ok()` (line 289); anything passing `validate` folds `Live` absent a covering revoke.

So the nine inconsistent shapes from the filing probe (min>max, expires_at<=not_before, fee_bps 99999, empty ledgers, source==dest, zero rate_num, zero cap, empty allowlist) still validate `Ok` and fold `Live` on current main; the `rate_den=0` control is still the only shape rejected. No matching fix PR was checked in this triage pass beyond the packet basis.

**Route:** fix packet per the issue acceptance — named `ValidateError` variants for min>max, expires_at<=not_before, fee_bps>10000, empty/same ledgers; a stated, tested rule for zero rate/cap and empty allowlist; per-shape tests with existing currency tests green.
